messages:
jess (sec-eng): Heads up — found a partner upload that included a wrapped Vault blob for a service account we no longer use. Need to evict access + rotate wrapping key. tagging ops: @owen, @kai, @maya

owen (sre): ack. can you paste the vault path and which SA/project?

jess (sec-eng): path: secret/data/partners/acme/payments. wrapped in kms:projects/acme-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap. exposed artifact came from partner integration job `partner-ingest-prod`.

kai (platform): are we sure the plaintext wasn't leaked? we only see the ciphertext blob in the upload archive.

jess (sec-eng): current audit shows only the partner CI identity accessed the secret in last 30d. no iam:serviceAccountKey.create events for our internal SAs. still treating as high risk since partner storage was public for ~12h.

maya (oncall): from ops POV we should: 1) disable partner SA immediately, 2) create new KMS key in our control project, 3) rewrap Vault secrets to new key, 4) rotate the downstream credentials. windows?

owen (sre): +1. Could cause a short burst of traffic while clients re-encrypt. Suggest a 30m maintenance window off-peak. also need a rollback plan if rewrap script fails.

jess (sec-eng): proposed timeline: today 17:00 PT. responsibilities: jess -> run audit queries & kick partner cutover, owen -> disable partner SA + apply rbinding, kai -> create new KMS key + run rewrap job, maya -> monitor and support rollback.

kai (platform): I'll create a symmetric cryptoKey with rotation disabled initially: `gcloud kms keys create new-partner-wrap --location=us-central1 --keyring=rw --purpose=encryption --projection=acme-prod` then set IAM for vault service account.

jess (sec-eng): rewrap snippet i plan to run from bastion (pseudo):

```bash
# get current ciphertext
C=\"$(vault kv get -field=ciphertext secret/partners/acme/payments)\"
# rewrap via vault transit with new key
vault write transit/rewrap key=new-partner-wrap ciphertext=$C
# verify and write back to secret path
vault kv put secret/partners/acme/payments ciphertext=$NEW_CIPHER
```

owen (sre): ensure we run a dry-run first that writes to `secret/temp-rewrap-check` and then diff the two ciphertexts. also capture `gcloud logging read` output for the last 24h: `gcloud logging read \"resource.type=cloud_run AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:\\"partner-ci@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com\\\"\" --limit 50`

maya (oncall): i'll open INC-1243 and post the timeline. set heartbeat to 5m and escalate to paging if error rate increases >2% for 10m.

jess (sec-eng): rollback plan: if rewrap fails or vault writes error, restore from snapshot we took few minutes before change: `vault snapshot save /tmp/pre-rewrap-$(date +%s).snap` and re-enable old SA if we disabled it too early.

kai (platform): one more: update audit forwarding so we keep raw access logs for 90d for this partner project (increase retention for `projects/acme-prod` logs to 90d). i'll queue the logging retention change and share the PR.

sec-bot: automated note — changed IAM binding detected for serviceAccount: partner-ci@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-23T16:45:00Z (refer INC-1243).

owen (sre): can we also rotate any long-lived tokens that the partner job may have printed to logs? running a grep on GCS logs for `Bearer` and `Authorization:` in the 12h window now.

jess (sec-eng): good catch. i'll run the search: `gsutil ls gs://partner-uploads/** | xargs -n1 gsutil cat | grep -E \"Bearer|Authorization:\" -n` and share results in INC-1243.

maya (oncall): i'm standing by at 17:00 PT. if anything unexpected, ping #release-war-room and i'll page infra. :thumbsup:

jess (sec-eng): thanks team. will post final checklist + the dry-run result in the incident thread before go-time.
